messages:
Beth (PM): Thinking about a lightweight "Preview session" in Console — let a user run a saved query against a chosen route+model combo and immediately see: routing split, estimated token cost, quota burn, and a small telemetry sample. Would help teams understand impact before they save/rollout. thoughts?
Kei (Eng): love the idea. main backend work is a simulation path vs actual inference. we can run a dry-run that estimates token counts + costs and optionally hit a canary model for latency samples.
Maya (Design): UX note: need to make it obvious this is a preview vs production run. show a header: "Preview session — no billing until you confirm" and a prominent toggle for "sample live response".
Zach (Infra): operationally we need to control which pools can be targeted for preview (hosted only? dedicated canary?). also need rate limits so people don't abuse preview to run large batches.
Kei (Eng): proposal: preview API accepts a routing hint object. by default route to a low-cost simulation engine that returns token estimates. if "live_sample:true" then route to canary-only pool with strict per-session caps. sample payload: `POST /api/preview_sessions {
  route: "billing/invoice",
  saved_query_id: "sq_123",
  routing_hints: [{pool:"dedicated-canary",pct:10},{pool:"hosted",pct:90}],
  live_sample: false
}`
Sam (Data): on telemetry we should emit a single event for preview-run with fields: saved_query_id, route, model_variant, estimated_tokens, estimated_cost, sample_flag. that lets us track adoption without polluting production logs.
Maya (Design): what about showing an expected SLA/latency preview? e.g., median from sample runs + 95th pct from historical similar requests. users care about tail latency when they pick model/route.
Kei (Eng): we can compute estimated latency from model profiles if not sampling live. if `live_sample=true` we show live numbers from the canary run.
Beth (PM): quota implications: should previews count against a team's preview quota only (not main quota)? they'd want to know how much main quota a rollout would burn. show both: preview-quota-burn (this session) and projected-main-burn-per-1000-requests.
Zach (Infra): agreed separate preview quota is easiest for enforcement. add a server-side cheap estimator for projected-main-burn so no one needs to actually run 1000 calls.
Kei (Eng): corner case: saved queries that use tool/function calling or external hooks — simulation must show a warning and only do token/cost estimates, not call external tools.
Maya (Design): UI detail: show a small timeline strip that lets user toggle between "route-level" and "model-level" preview. route-level = how different models + routing splits change cost; model-level = how same route behaves across model variants.
Sam (Data): sampling rate and sample size matter for telemetry quality. recommend default sample_rate=0.05 for preview live_sample and a max of 50 live sample requests per session.
Beth (PM): rollout plan: alpha behind feature-flag for internal teams, collect telemetry, then beta to customers with a banner explaining preview quotas.
Kei (Eng): infra notes: we'll need an endpoint in routing service to accept ephemeral routing weights for preview sessions only. TTL for session weights = session lifetime or 5m. must not affect global routing tables.
Zach (Infra): implement as overlay rules scoped to session-id. routing layer already supports overlays for experiments, reuse that path. ensure overlay cleanup if session crashes.
Maya (Design): small accessibility note: when preview shows "estimated cost" include a tooltip with calculation: tokens x per-token-price + rounding. keep language plain.
Sam (Data): for rollout gating, add a telemetry metric: preview_to_save_ratio by team. helps us see if preview actually prevents costly rollouts.
Beth (PM): ok next steps — Kei to draft API contract + backend plan, Maya to mock quick UI, Sam to propose telemetry schema, Zach to validate overlay approach and limits. will sync in 48h. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deployment check queued for feature flag `console-preview-session`. Current flag rollout: internal-only.
